name: hvac-erp-app
description: Full-Stack HVAC ERP Enterprise Operations Web Application

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npx prisma generate
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build && cd .. && node scripts/copy-dist.js
scripts.start: cd backend && npx prisma db push --skip-generate && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts && node dist/src/index.js
